basic_info.description: Immerse yourself in one of the best values at The Infinity, Residence #5F. This meticulously maintained south-facing one-bedroom, one-bathroom home offers a perfect blend of comfort, style, and sophistication. The thoughtful floor plan seamlessly connects the open kitchen to the dining and living areas, creating an inviting space for entertaining or relaxing. The eat-in kitchen is a chef's dream, boasting a Thermador refrigerator, Viking range, and premium stainless steel appliances.    The spacious primary bedroom features a large custom walk-in closet, with plenty of room for a cozy seating area. The spa-like bathroom offers ample storage, and the home is complete with in-unit washer/dryer and air conditioning for your convenience. Leased parking space has been secured in B2. The Infinity residences go beyond mere living spaces, they offer a lifestyle. Enjoy 24-hour doorman, a club room featuring a full catering kitchen, an approximately 5,000 sq ft fitness center, 75-ft lap pool, sauna, private theater room, business center, and more, ensuring that every aspect of your life is catered to within this exceptional community.
